findings.text:
目标是经常维护本地 DSH Agent 预设的使用者，交付单位是一份可挂载、可理解接线状态的预设目录。原办法是直接修改 YAML、Markdown 和技能目录，再排查文件为何没有被宿主消费。工作室把注入、文档、技能、工具行和普通文件区分建模，给每类声明消费者；例如文档同时需要技能目录与 docs 写回入口。增量在于把“有文件”和“已接线”分开，而不只是提供文本编辑器。

这个模型不会替代 DSH 自己的预设、工具和技能服务。它通过创建与修改已有配置，借用原生消费者生效；随包示例技能是模板，不能当成新的业务技能数。对只偶尔改一段提示的人，编辑器与版本管理已可能足够；多类条目经常增删、需要解释接线的人更可能受益，但尚无同任务人工耗时证据。

package 同时导出 host、client、inject、docs，bundle补丁只常驻挂载面板host；客户端注册侧栏和主面板，按钮通过 HTTP API 读取预设模型、修改文件或补接线。wireType 读取消费者清单，向已有插件列表追加 inject/docs 行，或补 customSkillDirs；缺少所需结构、复杂行内写法会明确拒绝，而不是猜测改写。

真正生效在预设挂载后。inject 为目录条目注册 systemPrompt.section/context，正文通过函数每次重读，结构变化由 fs.watch 重挂载；watch失败只记录警告，不保证结构热更新。docs 注册一个 doc_update 工具，按目录内文档名匹配，校验模式和非空内容，保留frontmatter后追加或替换正文，原子写文件并返回路径与行数。技能发现和预设本身仍由原生服务提供。

因此“写了文件”“补了配置”“已安装”“当前对话已采用”是不同阶段。面板不会自动证明每个预设的业务行为正确；文档替换也允许模型覆盖旧正文，不能等同版本回滚。
已检查packages/studio的host/client/core/inject/docs及包内模板；根README为作者说明，不把归档代码能力算作当前组件。
独立packages/studio组件经bundle加载host，客户端及运行时subpath同包分发；安装委托宿主pluginManager。

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Node≥22、DSH webServer | 面板host需要 | 注册本地API | 无法提供文件操作路由 |
| web客户端 slots/locale/theme | 界面需要 | 侧栏与主面板 | host可存在而界面不可见 |
| pluginManager | 安装/卸载时需要 | 管理link bundle | 明确报错；查询失败可能显示空列表 |
| 预设的原生消费者 | 运行预设时需要 | 技能、提示与工具生效 | 文件存在不等于可运行 |
| 可信且无链接跳转的本地根 | 受控试用前提 | 限制词法路径检查的风险 | 不用于不可信/多用户目录 |

启动需要 Node≥22、DSH webServer以及客户端 slots/locale/theme 等宿主服务；普通编辑和安装不是同一个依赖层级，安装另需 pluginManager，预设运行另需其声明的原生消费者。使用者必须选择根目录、保留备份，并理解修改patch的挂载时机。

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次使用 | 本机存储与既有DSH，金额未知 | 配置可信根、备份、确认预设消费者 | 未测配置时间与跨平台兼容 |
| 持续使用 | 本地文件读写及预设运行资源 | 校对变更，必要时开新对话 | 文本热读不等于patch热生效 |
| 失败恢复 | 备份空间与可能的重装资源 | 核对宿主安装状态和半建模板目录 | 组件无跨文件自动回滚 |
| 退出 | 保留用户文件 | 卸预设后停用工作室，核对link状态 | 移除面板不删除本地预设资料 |

金额与人工时间未取得，不把本地工具称为无成本。doc_update会持久化正文，退出也不能自动撤销模型的历史写入。模板和工具列表不覆盖任意第三方预设，复杂YAML需要手工维护。
先用可信、无符号链接的单一预设备份目录，核对接线、磁盘内容、新会话行为和卸载状态；任一不一致就停止写入并用宿主管理器与编辑器恢复。优先作者声明实测平台，其他平台先检查模板目录分隔符。依据见 [Q06](#research-q06)。

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 接线可解释性 | 消费者表和接线步骤可追溯 | 是否减少实际维护错误/耗时 |
| 文档回写 | doc_update保留frontmatter并改正文 | 多人并发与业务内容正确性 |
| 热更新 | 正文重读与目录监听 | watcher失败及不同平台行为 |
[Q02](#research-q02) 的单一消费者模型及按行修改避免无关YAML重序列化，值得配置工具借鉴；[Q03](#research-q03) 表明移植前还需真实路径边界、跨文件计划和并发控制，不把rename称为完整事务。
[Q01](#research-q01) 与 [Q02](#research-q02) 支持把五类条目及其消费者放入统一模型，减少“文件存在但无人消费”的解释落差。贡献是预设维护的组合与接线可见性，原生模型、技能发现和安装事务仍由DSH提供。
[Q03](#research-q03) 显示主要限制是写入边界仍为词法路径检查，安装与模板创建也没有本组件的跨文件回滚；它适合可信本地目录，不能据界面便利推出安全沙箱或任意平台可用。

值得验证的方向是把当前消费者清单扩成可预览的接线变更计划，先显示“将追加哪些插件行、哪些文件会变化、哪些服务仍缺失”，再允许写入。推导来自 core.TYPES把内容与消费者统一登记，以及wireType已经能返回实际变更步骤。相对现有按钮，它增加的是写前可审阅性和解释能力，不是宣称能静态证明宿主运行成功。

最小实验应固定一个正常预设、一个缺skill-filesystem预设和一个复杂YAML预设，对照现有按钮与预览方案，比较误写、漏接线、恢复人工量及用户能否预测结果。若预览继续把静态存在误报为可加载，或为维护计划引入第二套易漂移规则，应停止该方向。另一项必要工程前置是按真实路径约束文件边界；这可以单独验证，不把修复计划当现有安全保证。 具体依据见 [Q05](#research-q05)。

technical.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) core.TYPES与wireType相对编辑器增加统一消费关系，novelty是25%适配而非首创；机制把文件与接线状态关联、简化重复YAML操作各50%；消费者表可迁移到其他配置工具故transferability50%，未有跨宿主验证不足75%。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 从纯文件维护变为条目与消费者维护，workflow50%；交付仍是既有DSH预设仅可见性改善，delivery25%；面板降低部分YAML门槛但需技术排障，reach25%；[Q04](#research-q04) 未改变计费/资源组织方式，economics0，不把未测费用补0。

recommendation.reason: 经常维护本地 DSH 预设且能回查文件变更的使用者，可在可信且无符号链接的备份目录试用工作室。相比手改 YAML，它把条目需要的消费者和接线步骤显示在同一界面，源码支持这一操作增量。若新会话能力与界面状态不一致或安装状态不清，应停止写入并回到宿主管理器和编辑器恢复备份。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) core.js:296-358及741-776明确多类内容漏接消费者的重复摩擦，超过用途明确的50%；可解释本地维护者为何承担负担取75%，但无持续需求实证不足100%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) wireType:741-776与doc_update:137-168展示从文件到消费者/回写的实质操作减少，超过只有可解释潜力50%；[Q03](#research-q03)词法边界和平台条件收窄可信本地任务而未击穿增量，取75%不达关键优势全面验证100%。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 已跟到客户端→路由→文件、消费者→提示/文档回执和安装失败分支，超过片段支持25%；未运行插件/宿主，取源码上限50%，不取75%。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04) index:475-519有卸载和失败回执且可保留编辑器退路，超过恢复缺口严重25%；但[Q03](#research-q03)多文件无回滚、平台模板、人工核对显著，取50%不足负担较轻75%。

publication.summaries.text: 在侧栏编辑本地预设文件、注入、文档、技能和工具接线，并管理预设安装。

items.界面: 预设工作室侧栏与主面板
items.Host 路由: 本地预设读取、编辑、接线、创建及安装卸载
items.模型工具: 预设挂载docs子入口后注册doc_update
items.事件监听: inject目录结构监听与提示贡献重建

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 预设文件编辑 | 管理YAML、Markdown等允许类型 | 可信根目录，编辑冲突返回409 |
| 条目消费者接线 | 补注入、文档和技能消费配置 | 依赖支持的YAML形状，复杂行内写法拒绝 |
| 模板创建 | 复制并替换新预设占位符 | 多步写入无整目录回滚，模板含Windows路径 |
| 预设安装卸载 | 调用DSH管理器管理link bundle | 需pluginManager，失败后核对实际状态 |
| 提示投递 | 将注入目录按顺序注册到会话 | 需预设挂载inject，watch失败会警告 |
| doc_update | 追加或替换已有文档正文 | 需预设挂载docs，非版本回滚或写前审批 |

      "path": "README.md",
      "content": "# 预设工作室 · DSH Preset Studio

> A visual studio for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) agent presets:
> files, prompt injections, documents, skills and tool rows in one sidebar panel.
> Editing is line-based, so your YAML comments and layout survive; every preset can be
> installed/uninstalled from the panel. Requires DSH and Node ≥ 22.

---

一个给 **DeepSeek Harness**（DSH）用的预设工作台。它把「一个 agent 预设」拆成可管理的条目，
让你在侧边栏里读写、开关、接线，而不用手抠 YAML。

本来是我自己改预设用的，后来发现它顺手，就放出来了。

![预设工作室：左边是五类条目和接线状态，右边直接编辑文件](packages/studio/assets/panel.png)

## 它解决什么

DSH 的预设是一个目录 + 一份 `cordis.patch.yml`。预设里的东西其实分成五类，但 DSH 只认文件。
这个面板把五类分开管，并且**说清每一类靠什么才生效**：

| 条目 | 放在哪 | 谁消费它（没有它就只是文件） |
|---|---|---|
| 注入 | `注入/*.md` | `dsh-preset-studio/inject` 一行 |
| 文档 | `文档/*.md` | 技能目录 + `dsh-preset-studio/docs` 一行 |
| 技能 | `技能/<名>/SKILL.md` | 技能目录（`customSkillDirs`） |
| 工具 | `cordis.patch.yml` 里的行 | 它自己 |
| 文件 | `cordis.patch.yml`、`package.json`、`说明.md` | 不需要 |

某个条目「接上」了没有，面板直接说，不用你去猜为什么改了没反应。

## 一个包，三个入口

装一次，三个入口各管一件事：

| 入口 | 职责 | 什么时候加载 |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh-preset-studio` | 面板本体：读写预设文件、装/卸预设。**不含任何运行时逻辑** | 作为 bundle 常驻 |
| `dsh-preset-studio/inject` | 投递器：一个目录 → 系统提示词 | 预设挂载时才 import |
| `dsh-preset-studio/docs` | 写回器：一个目录 → 一个 `doc_update` 工具 | 预设挂载时才 import |

后两个是**预设挂载时才 import 的零件**，不是宿主插件。它们和面板同一个安装，但在模块层是分开的：
`inject.js` 只 import `frontmatter.js`，不 import 面板的任何东西。所以一个只想投递注入的预设，
加载的仍然只有那几百行。

## 安装

前提：已装 DSH，`node -v` ≥ 22。

**桌面版**：插件市场的 Discover 里搜 `预设工作室` 或 `preset studio`，点安装，然后重启 DSH。
侧边栏就会出现「预设工作室」。

**有 `dsh` 命令行**（桌面版不带这个命令）：一条命令，profile 名按你的实际情况改。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:HYcally/dsh-preset-studio#path:/packages/studio"
```

装完重启 DSH。

<details>
<summary>本地开发：直接链一个 checkout</summary>

```bash
# Windows 的 profile 通常在 %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop
pnpm add --dir "<profile 目录>" "link:<仓库绝对路径>/packages/studio"
```

然后把 **`dsh-preset-studio`** 追加到 `<profile 目录>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`：

```json
"bundles": [ "...", "dsh-preset-studio" ]
```

重启 DSH。

</details>

> `packages/studio/cordis.patch.yml` 里没有任何绝对路径。一个 checkout 默认把仓库里的
> `预设/` 当根目录、`模板/基础/` 当模板；装进 profile 的副本则用包自带的
> `packages/studio/template/`，根目录落到 `~/.dsh/presets`（首次启动时创建）。
> 想指到别处，在那一行的 `config` 里写 `root:` / `template:`。

## 第一次用

1. 右上角 **+ 新建预设** → 填显示名（中文可以）和一个 id（小写英文）
2. 它会从模板复制一份并把占位符换成你的路径——**接线是预先接好的**
3. 在「注入」里改人设，在「文档」里写设定，在「技能」里写做法
4. 右上角 **装进 DSH**
5. 到聊天界面选这个预设，**开一个新对话**

## 模板

`packages/studio/template/`（checkout 里也可以用 `模板/基础/` 覆盖它）是一个不带绝对路径的骨架，
靠五个占位符工作：

| 占位符 | 替换成 |
|---|---|
| `__TITLE__` | 显示名 |
| `__PRESET_ID__` | 预设 id |
| `__PACKAGE__` | `dsh-preset-<id>` |
| `__DIR__` | 新预设的绝对路径 |
| `__PERSONA__` | 由显示名生成的人设前缀 |

注入序号按段位排，留空位以后插新的不用重排：

| 段位 | 放什么 |
|---|---|
| 10–19 | 人设、输出协议 |
| 20–29 | 风格、人称 |
| 30–49 | 纪律、边界 |
| 50–69 | 字数、节奏 |
| 70–89 | 模式 |
| 90+ | 临时补丁 |

## 测试

```bash
npm test                      # 全部（需要 DSH 在跑的那项会自动跳过）
node tools/studio-flow.mjs    # 宿主：建条目 / 开关 / 接线 / 加工具 / 从模板新建（临时目录）
node tools/injector-test.mjs  # 投递器：注册 / 改内容 / 增删文件
node tools/studio-client.mjs  # 面板：整页渲染（需要 DSH_WEB_URL）
```

前两个自包含，不需要 DSH 在运行；第三个会真的请求你本地的 DSH。

## 目录结构

```
packages/studio/    唯一的包：面板 + 投递器 + 写回器 + 模板
   index.js         宿主路由（读写预设文件、装/卸预设）
   core.js          条目模型：类型、消费者、patch 行读写
   client.js        侧边栏面板
   inject.js        入口 /inject —— 投递器
   docs.js          入口 /docs   —— 写回器
   template/        新建预设时的骨架
预设/               你的预设（默认不进 git）
tools/              验证脚本
归档/               旧版本与源料，只作参照
```

## 已知限制

- **预设内容在挂载时读一次。** 改了 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的插件行，要开新对话才生效；
  注入/文档/技能的**正文**是例外，下一轮就生效。
- **只在 Windows 上实测过。** 路径全部走 `path.join`，理论上 macOS / Linux 可用，
  但欢迎你提 issue 告诉我实际情况。
- **只管理文件系统里的预设**（`<root>/<名字>/cordis.patch.yml`），不管理从 npm 装的第三方预设。
- **根目录只能写在配置里**，面板里还没有切换根目录的按钮。默认值覆盖了绝大多数情况：
  checkout 用仓库的 `预设/`，装进 profile 用 `~/.dsh/presets`。

function sendJson(res, status, payload) {
  res.writeHead(status, { 'content-type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'cache-control': 'no-store' })
  res.end(JSON.stringify(payload))
}

function isLoopback(req) {
  const address = req.socket?.remoteAddress ?? ''
  return address === '127.0.0.1' || address === '::1' || address === '::ffff:127.0.0.1'
}

/**
 * A browser sends `Origin`; a page on another site is not the panel. The routes
 * are loopback-fenced already, so a missing-origin check would leave any web
 * page free to POST into the preset folder — a simple request without a custom
 * header skips the preflight. Its `Origin` must therefore match the `Host` it
 * is talking to. Non-browser clients (the test harness, curl) send no origin
 * and stay allowed; they are already loopback-only.
 */
function isSameOrigin(req) {
  const origin = req.headers?.origin
  if (typeof origin !== 'string' || origin === '') return true
  if (origin === 'null') return false
  try {
    return new URL(origin).host === String(req.headers?.host ?? '')
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

function guard(req, res, method) {
  if (!isLoopback(req)) {
    sendJson(res, 403, { error: 'forbidden: loopback-only' })
    return false
  }
  if (!isSameOrigin(req)) {
    sendJson(res, 403, { error: 'forbidden: cross-origin' })
    return false
  }
  if (req.method !== method) {
    sendJson(res, 405, { error: 'method not allowed: ' + req.method })
    return false
  }
  return true
}

async function readJsonBody(req) {
  const chunks = []
  for await (const chunk of req) chunks.push(chunk)
  const raw = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8')
  if (raw.trim() === '') return null
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    throw new Error('invalid JSON body')
  }
}

/**
 * pnpm leaves a `link:` bundle's junction behind after removal; it only bites
 * when the target disappears. Best effort: never fail the uninstall over it.
 */
function dropStaleLink(profileDir, bundleName, targetDir) {
  if (!profileDir || !bundleName) return false
  const linkPath = path.join(profileDir, 'node_modules', ...bundleName.split('/'))
  try {
    if (!fs.lstatSync(linkPath).isSymbolicLink()) return false
  } catch {
    return false
  }
  let resolved = ''
  try {
    resolved = fs.realpathSync(linkPath)
  } catch {
    return false
  }
  if (!samePath(resolved, targetDir)) return false
  try {
    fs.rmdirSync(linkPath)
    return true
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

/** True when a patch `name:` owns the filesystem skill provider. */
const SKILL_PROVIDER = /dsh-skill-filesystem/

/**
 * Locate the `skill-filesystem` row and the shape of its `customSkillDirs` list.
 * Line-based on purpose: the writer must not reformat what it is not changing.
 */
function locateSkillRow(text) {
  const eol = text.includes('\r\n') ? '\r\n' : '\n'
  const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/)
  const result = {
    eol,
    lines,
    rowIndex: -1,
    rowIndent: 0,
    blockEnd: lines.length,
    configIndex: -1,
    dirsIndex: -1,
    dirsInline: false,
    items: [],
  }
  let current = null
  for (let index = 0; index < lines.length; index += 1) {
    const idMatch = /^(\s*)-\s+id:\s*(.+?)\s*$/.exec(lines[index])
    if (idMatch) {
      current = { index, indent: idMatch[1].length }
      continue

    if (!current) continue
    const nameMatch = /^(\s*)name:\s*(.+?)\s*$/.exec(lines[index])
    if (nameMatch && nameMatch[1].length === current.indent + 2 && SKILL_PROVIDER.test(nameMatch[2])) {

      result.rowIndent = current.indent
      break

  if (result.rowIndex < 0) return result

  const base = result.rowIndent
  let seenDirs = false
  for (let index = result.rowIndex + 1; index < lines.length; index += 1) {
    const line = lines[index]
    if (line.trim() === '') continue
    const indent = line.length - line.trimStart().length
    if (indent <= base) {

      break

    const trimmed = line.trim()
    if (indent === base + 2) {

      else if (seenDirs) break
      continue

    if (indent === base + 4) {
      const dirsMatch = /^customSkillDirs:\s*(.*)$/.exec(trimmed)
      if (dirsMatch) {
        result.dirsIndex = index
        result.dirsInline = dirsMatch[1].trim() !== ''
        seenDirs = true
      } else if (seenDirs) {
        break
      }
      continue
    }
    if (seenDirs && indent === base + 6) {
      const itemMatch = /^-\s*(.+?)\s*$/.exec(trimmed)
      if (itemMatch) {
        result.items.push({ index, value: itemMatch[1].replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '') })
      }
    }
  }
  return result
}

  const quoted = yamlString(targetDir)
  if (found.dirsIndex >= 0) {
    const at = found.items.length > 0 ? found.items[found.items.length - 1].index + 1 : found.dirsIndex + 1
    found.lines.splice(at, 0, pad(found.rowIndent + 6) + '- ' + quoted)
  } else if (found.configIndex >= 0) {
    found.lines.splice(found.configIndex + 1, 0, pad(found.rowIndent + 4) + 'customSkillDirs:', pad(found.rowIndent + 6) + '- ' + quoted)
  } else {
    found.lines.splice(
      found.blockEnd,
      0,
      pad(found.rowIndent + 2) + 'config:',
      pad(found.rowIndent + 4) + 'customSkillDirs:',
      pad(found.rowIndent + 6) + '- ' + quoted,
    )
  }
  return { found: true, changed: true, text: found.lines.join(found.eol) }
}

/** Locate the preset's `plugins:` list: its line, its indent, and its last line. */
function locatePluginsList(text) {
  const eol = text.includes('\r\n') ? '\r\n' : '\n'
  const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/)
  let index = -1
  let indent = 0
  for (let cursor = 0; cursor < lines.length; cursor += 1) {
    const match = /^(\s*)plugins:\s*$/.exec(lines[cursor])
    if (match) {
      index = cursor
      indent = match[1].length
      break
    }
  }
  if (index < 0) return { found: false, lines, eol }
  let last = index
  for (let cursor = index + 1; cursor < lines.length; cursor += 1) {
    const line = lines[cursor]
    if (line.trim() === '') continue
    const level = line.length - line.trimStart().length
    if (level <= indent) break
    last = cursor
  }
  return { found: true, index, indent, last, lines, eol }
}

/** Append one entry at the end of the preset's `plugins:` list. */
function appendPluginsBlock(text, block) {
  const found = locatePluginsList(text)
  if (!found.found) return { found: false }
  const item = found.indent + 2
  const built = block.map(([depth, line]) => ' '.repeat(item + depth * 2) + line)
  found.lines.splice(found.last + 1, 0, ...built)
  return { found: true, text: found.lines.join(found.eol) }
}

/**
 * Read the patch's plugin rows without a YAML parser: list items that look like
 * `- id: <name>` plus the `name`, `group` and `disabled` properties one level
 * deeper.
 */
export function parsePatchRows(text) {
  const lines = String(text ?? '').split(/\r?\n/)
  const rows = []
  const stack = []
  let current = null
  for (let index = 0; index < lines.length; index += 1) {
    const line = lines[index]
    const idMatch = /^(\s*)-\s+id:\s*(.+?)\s*$/.exec(line)
    if (idMatch) {
      const indent = idMatch[1].length
      while (stack.length > 0 && stack[stack.length - 1].indent >= indent) stack.pop()
      const parent = stack.length > 0 ? stack[stack.length - 1] : null
      const row = {
        id: idMatch[2].replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, ''),
        line: index,
        indent,
        name: '',
        group: parent && parent.groupOnly ? parent.id : null,
        disabled: undefined,
        groupOnly: false,
      }
      rows.push(row)
      stack.push(row)
      current = row
      continue
    }
    if (!current) continue
    const indent = line.length - line.trimStart().length
    if (indent <= current.indent) continue
    if (current.name === '') {
      const nameMatch = /^\s*name:\s*(.+?)\s*$/.exec(line)
      if (nameMatch) {
        current.name = nameMatch[1].replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')
        continue
      }
    }
    const groupMatch = /^\s*group:\s*(true|false)\s*$/.exec(line)
    if (groupMatch) current.groupOnly = groupMatch[1] === 'true'
    const disabledMatch = /^\s*disabled:\s*(.+?)\s*$/.exec(line)
    if (disabledMatch) current.disabled = disabledMatch[1]
  }
  return rows
}

/** True when a patch row's package name looks like a model-facing tool row. */
export function isToolRow(name) {
  if (typeof name !== 'string' || name === '') return false
  return /(^|[-/])dsh-tool-/.test(name) || /\/tools$/.test(name)
}

/* ── readers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function readFlat(type, preset) {
  const dir = path.join(preset.dir, type.dir)
  let exists = false
  try {
    exists = fs.statSync(dir).isDirectory()
  } catch {
    exists = false
  }
  const items = []
  let children = []
  if (exists) {
    try {
      children = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })
    } catch {
      children = []
    }
  }
  for (const child of children) {
    if (!child.isFile() || !child.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.md')) continue
    const file = path.join(dir, child.name)
    let text = ''
    let mtime = 0
    try {
      text = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')
      mtime = fs.statSync(file).mtimeMs
    } catch {
      continue
    }
    const split = splitFrontmatter(text)
    const head = split ? split.head : ''
    const body = split ? split.rest : text
    const name = readField(head, 'name') || child.name.slice(0, -3)
    const description = readField(head, 'description') || ''
    if (type.id === 'inject') {
      const rawRole = (readField(head, 'role') || 'system').toLowerCase()
      const role = rawRole === 'user' || rawRole === 'assistant' ? rawRole : 'system'
      items.push({
        name,
        fileName: child.name,
        path: file,
        role,
        order: readNumber(head, 'order') ?? 999,
        enabled: readBoolean(readField(head, type.toggleField)) !== false,
        valid: split !== null,
        preview: body.trim().split(/\r?\n/)[0] || '',
        mtime,
      })
    } else {
      items.push({
        name,
        fileName: child.name,
        path: file,
        description,
        chars: body.trim().length,
        enabled: readBoolean(readField(head, type.toggleField)) !== true,
        valid: split !== null && SLUG.test(name) && description !== '',
        mtime,
      })
    }
  }
  items.sort((a, b) =>
    type.orderBy === 'order'
      ? a.order - b.order || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'zh-Hans-CN')
      : a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'zh-Hans-CN'),
  )
  return { dir, exists, items }
}

function readFolder(type, preset) {
  const dir = path.join(preset.dir, type.dir)
  let exists = false
  try {
    exists = fs.statSync(dir).isDirectory()
  } catch {
    exists = false
  }
  const items = []
  let children = []
  if (exists) {
    try {
      children = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })
    } catch {
      children = []
    }
  }
  for (const child of children) {
    let file = null
    let dirName = null
    if (child.isDirectory()) {
      const candidate = path.join(dir, child.name, 'SKILL.md')
      try {
        if (fs.statSync(candidate).isFile()) {
          file = candidate
          dirName = child.name
        }
      } catch {
        file = null
      }
    } else if (child.isFile() && child.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.md')) {
      file = path.join(dir, child.name)
      dirName = child.name.slice(0, -3)
    }
    if (!file) continue
    let text = ''
    let mtime = 0
    try {
      text = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')
      mtime = fs.statSync(file).mtimeMs
    } catch {
      continue
    }
    const split = splitFrontmatter(text)
    const head = split ? split.head : ''
    const name = readField(head, 'name') || dirName
    items.push({
      name,
      dirName,
      path: file,
      description: readField(head, 'description') || '',
      enabled: readBoolean(readField(head, type.toggleField)) !== true,
      valid: split !== null,
      mtime,
    })
  }
  items.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'zh-Hans-CN'))
  return { dir, exists, items }
}

function readRows(type, preset, rows) {
  const items = []
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (row.groupOnly) continue
    if (!isToolRow(row.name)) continue
    const raw = typeof row.disabled === 'string' ? row.disabled : ''
    const auto = raw.includes('!!js')
    const disabled = auto ? false : raw.trim().toLowerCase() === 'true'
    items.push({
      name: row.id,
      id: row.id,
      packageName: row.name,
      group: row.group,
      auto,
      disabled,
      enabled: auto ? true : !disabled,
      expression: auto ? raw : undefined,
    })
  }
  items.sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id))
  return { dir: null, exists: true, items }
}

/* ── wiring state ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function wiringOf(type, preset, patchText, rows) {
  const dir = type.dir ? path.join(preset.dir, type.dir) : null
  const dirs = readSkillDirs(patchText)
  const missing = []
  for (const id of type.consumers) {
    if (id === 'skill-dir') {
      if (!dirs.dirs.some((entry) => samePath(entry, dir))) missing.push(CONSUMER_DEFS[id].label)
      continue
    }
    const row = consumerRow(id)
    const present = rows.some((item) => item.name === row.name && !item.groupOnly)
    if (!present) missing.push(CONSUMER_DEFS[id].label)
  }
  return {
    dir,
    wired: type.consumers.length === 0 || missing.length === 0,
    missing,
    consumers: type.consumers.map((id) => ({ id, label: CONSUMER_DEFS[id].label })),
    skillDirs: dirs.dirs,
  }
}

/** Everything the panel needs about one type inside one preset. */
function readType(type, preset, patchText, rows) {
  let read
  if (type.shape === 'flat') read = readFlat(type, preset)
  else if (type.shape === 'folder') read = readFolder(type, preset)
  else if (type.shape === 'rows') read = readRows(type, preset, rows)
  else read = null
  const wiring = wiringOf(type, preset, patchText, rows)
  return {
    id: type.id,
    label: type.label,
    dir: read ? read.dir : null,
    exists: read ? read.exists : true,
    items: read ? read.items : [],
    wiring,
  }
}

/** The preset's own files, in the order a preset is read. */
function discoverFiles(preset) {
  const files = []
  for (const name of PRESET_FILES) {
    const abs = path.join(preset.dir, name)
    try {
      const stat = fs.statSync(abs)
      files.push({
        name,
        path: abs,
        label: preset.name + ' / ' + name,
        group: preset.name,
        size: stat.size,
        mtime: stat.mtimeMs,
      })
    } catch {
      /* missing files simply do not appear */
    }
  }
  return files
}

/** A preset directory's manifest, or the reason it cannot be installed. */
export function readPresetManifest(dir) {
  let parsed
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, reason: '这个预设的 package.json 不存在，或者不是有效 JSON' }
  }
  if (typeof parsed?.name !== 'string' || parsed.name.trim() === '') {
    return { ok: false, reason: '这个预设的 package.json 里没有 name' }
  }
  const patch = parsed?.dsh?.bundle?.patch
  if (typeof patch !== 'string' || patch.trim() === '') {
    return { ok: false, reason: 'package.json 里缺 dsh.bundle.patch：DSH 不认它是一个预设包' }
  }
  return { ok: true, name: parsed.name.trim(), version: parsed.version, patch: patch.trim() }
}

/** Read one preset completely. */
export function readPreset(preset) {
  const patchPath = path.join(preset.dir, 'cordis.patch.yml')
  let patchText = ''
  let patchExists = true
  try {
    patchText = fs.readFileSync(patchPath, 'utf8')
  } catch {
    patchExists = false
  }
  const rows = parsePatchRows(patchText)
  const entries = {}
  for (const type of TYPES) entries[type.id] = readType(type, preset, patchText, rows)
  return {
    name: preset.name,
    dir: preset.dir,
    package: preset.package,
    patchPath,
    patchExists,
    files: discoverFiles(preset),
    entries,
  }
}

/* ── writing: create an entry ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function frontmatterFor(type, values) {
  const lines = []
  for (const field of type.create.fields ?? []) {
    const raw = values[field.key] !== undefined && values[field.key] !== '' ? values[field.key] : field.default
    if (raw === undefined) continue
    if (field.key === 'name') lines.push('name: ' + raw)
    else if (field.kind === 'number') lines.push(field.key + ': ' + Number(raw))
    else if (field.key === 'description') lines.push('description: ' + JSON.stringify(String(raw)))
    else if (field.kind === 'select') lines.push(field.key + ': ' + raw)
  }
  if (type.toggleField === 'enabled') lines.push('enabled: true')
  if (type.toggleField === 'disable-model-invocation') lines.push('disable-model-invocation: false')
  return '---\n' + lines.join('\n') + '\n---\n\n' + (type.create.body ?? '') 
}

/** Create one entry; returns the file it created so the client can open it. */
export function createEntry(preset, typeId, values) {
  const type = TYPES.find((item) => item.id === typeId)
  if (!type || !type.create) throw new Error('这种条目不能新建')
  const name = String(values.name ?? '').trim()
  if (name === '') throw new Error('名字不能为空')
  if (type.create.slug && !SLUG.test(name)) throw new Error('名字只能用小写字母、数字和连字符，例如 cast-notes')
  for (const field of type.create.fields ?? []) {
    if (field.required && String(values[field.key] ?? '').trim() === '') throw new Error(field.label + '不能为空')
  }
  const dir = path.join(preset.dir, type.dir)
  const file = type.shape === 'folder' ? path.join(dir, name, 'SKILL.md') : path.join(dir, safeFileName(name) + '.md')
  if (!isInside(preset.dir, file)) throw new Error('path is outside the preset')
  if (fs.existsSync(file)) throw new Error('同名的' + type.label + '已存在')
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true })
  writeAtomic(file, frontmatterFor(type, values))
  return { path: file, name }
}

/* ── writing: toggle one entry ────────────────────────────────────────────── */

export function toggleEntry(typeId, file, enabled) {
  const type = TYPES.find((item) => item.id === typeId)
  if (!type || !type.toggleField) throw new Error('这种条目没有开关')
  if (typeId === 'tool') throw new Error('工具开关按行处理')
  const split = splitFrontmatter(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'))
  if (!split) throw new Error('这个文件没有 frontmatter，无法开关')
  const value = type.toggleField === 'enabled' ? (enabled ? 'true' : 'false') : enabled ? 'false' : 'true'
  const head = setField(split.head, type.toggleField, value)
  writeAtomic(file, '---' + split.eol + head + split.eol + '---' + split.eol + split.rest)
  return { path: file, enabled }
}

/** Set one frontmatter field, adding it when absent. */
function setField(head, key, value) {
  const re = new RegExp('^(' + key.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&') + '\\s*:\\s*).*$')
  const eol = head.includes('\r\n') ? '\r\n' : '\n'
  let replaced = false
  const next = head.split(/\r?\n/).map((line) => {
    if (!re.test(line)) return line
    replaced = true
    return key + ': ' + value
  })
  if (!replaced) next.push(key + ': ' + value)
  return next.join(eol)
}

/* ── writing: wire one type ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/**
 * Perform every missing consumer step for one type.
 * Returns the steps that actually changed something.
 */
export function wireType(preset, typeId) {
  const type = TYPES.find((item) => item.id === typeId)
  if (!type || type.consumers.length === 0) throw new Error('这种条目不需要接线')
  const patchPath = path.join(preset.dir, 'cordis.patch.yml')
  if (!fs.existsSync(patchPath)) throw new Error('这个预设没有 cordis.patch.yml')
  let text = fs.readFileSync(patchPath, 'utf8')
  if (text.trim() === '') throw new Error('这个预设的 cordis.patch.yml 还是空的。先照「示例预设」抄一份过来，再接。')
  const dir = path.join(preset.dir, type.dir)
  const rows = parsePatchRows(text)
  const done = []
  for (const id of type.consumers) {
    if (id === 'skill-dir') {
      const result = wireSkillDir(text, dir)
      if (!result.found) throw new Error('这个预设有 cordis.patch.yml，但里面没有 skill-filesystem 那一行。照「示例预设」抄那三行过来，再接。')
      if (result.inline) throw new Error('customSkillDirs 现在是行内写法，面板改不了，请手动改成多行列表')
      if (result.changed) {
        text = result.text
        done.push('技能目录')
      }
      continue
    }
    const row = consumerRow(id)
    if (rows.some((item) => item.name === row.name && !item.groupOnly)) continue
    const result = appendPluginsBlock(text, [
      [0, '- id: ' + row.id],
      [1, "name: '" + row.name + "'"],
      [1, 'config:'],
      [2, 'dir: ' + yamlString(dir)],
    ])
    if (!result.found) throw new Error('这个预设的 cordis.patch.yml 里找不到 plugins: 列表。照「示例预设」抄一份再试。')
    text = result.text
    done.push(CONSUMER_DEFS[id].label)
  }
  if (done.length > 0) writeAtomic(patchPath, text)
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true })
  return { changed: done.length > 0, steps: done, patchPath }
}

/* ── writing: tools are patch rows ────────────────────────────────────────── */

/** Every row that is a model-facing tool, with its resolved enabled state. */
export function readToolRows(preset) {
  let text = ''
  try {
    text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(preset.dir, 'cordis.patch.yml'), 'utf8')
  } catch {
    return []
  }
  return readRows(TYPES.find((type) => type.id === 'tool'), preset, parsePatchRows(text)).items
}

/** Switch one tool row on or off by editing only its `disabled:` line. */
export function toggleToolRow(preset, id, enabled) {
  const patchPath = path.join(preset.dir, 'cordis.patch.yml')
  const text = fs.readFileSync(patchPath, 'utf8')
  const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/)
  const row = parsePatchRows(text).find((item) => item.id === id)

        return false
      }
    })

/** Every preset directory under the configured roots. */
export function presetDirs(roots) {
  const found = []
  for (const root of roots) {
    let children = []
    try {
      children = fs.readdirSync(root, { withFileTypes: true })
    } catch {
      children = []
    }
    for (const child of children) {
      if (!child.isDirectory()) continue
      const dir = path.join(root, child.name)
      let hasPatch = false
      try {
        hasPatch = fs.statSync(path.join(dir, 'cordis.patch.yml')).isFile()

      found.push({ name: child.name, dir, package: manifest.ok ? manifest.name : null })

  }

   The panel floats over the user's wallpaper, so nothing that carries text may
   inherit its colour from the theme: a bright theme paints "solid" buttons
   white-on-white. These rules take text, surfaces and the accent from our own
   palette, and keep the panel legible on any background. */

.dcm-list{background:var(--cm-card);border-color:var(--cm-hairline)}
.dcm-picks{background:var(--cm-card)}

.dcm-sw{border-color:var(--cm-hairline-strong)}

.dcm-sw[data-on="1"]::after{background:var(--cm-accent)}
.dcm-editor{color:var(--cm-text);background:var(--cm-code);border-color:var(--cm-hairline)}
.dcm-editor::placeholder{color:var(--cm-text-dim)}

.dcm .dcm-install .dcm-chip{color:var(--cm-text-dim)}

    function installStyles() {
      if (typeof document === 'undefined') return
      const head = document.head || document.documentElement
      if (!head) return
      let element = document.getElementById(STYLE_ID)
      if (!element) {
        element = document.createElement('style')
        element.id = STYLE_ID
        head.appendChild(element)
      }
      element.textContent = STYLES
    }

    /* ── helpers ── */
    function confirmText(message) {
      try {
        return window.confirm(message)
      } catch {
        return false
      }
    }

    function formatSize(bytes) {
      if (typeof bytes !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(bytes)) return ''
      return bytes < 1024 ? bytes + ' ' + t('unit.bytes') : (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' ' + t('unit.kb')
    }

    function statusColor(error, dirty, saved) {
      if (error) return 'var(--dsw-alias-state-error-primary)'
      if (dirty) return 'var(--dsw-alias-state-warn-primary)'
      if (saved) return 'var(--dsw-alias-state-success-primary)'
      return 'var(--dsw-alias-state-idle-primary)'
    }

    function statusLabel(error, dirty, saved) {
      if (error) return error
      if (dirty) return t('state.dirty')
      if (saved) return t('state.saved')
      return t('state.clean')
    }

    /* ── small components ── */
    function StudioIcon(props) {
      const size = props && typeof props.size === 'number' ? props.size : 20
      return h(
        'svg',
        { viewBox: '0 0 24 24', width: size, height: size, fill: 'none', stroke: 'currentColor', strokeWidth: 1.6, strokeLinecap: 'round', strokeLinejoin: 'round' },
        h('rect', { x: 3, y: 4, width: 18, height: 16, rx: 2.5 }),
        h('path', { d: 'M9 4v16' }),
        h('path', { d: 'M12.5 9h5.5' }),
        h('path', { d: 'M12.5 13h5.5' }),
        h('path', { d: 'M12.5 17h3' }),
      )
    }

    function Switch(props) {
      return h('button', {
        type: 'button',
        className: 'dcm-sw',
        'data-on': props.on ? '1' : '0',
        disabled: props.disabled,
        title: props.title || '',
        'aria-label': props.label || '',
        onClick: props.onChange,
      })
    }

    function Chip(props) {
      return h('span', { className: 'dcm-chip', title: props.title || '' }, props.text)
    }

    function Notice(props) {
      return h('div', { className: 'dcm-notice', 'data-tone': props.tone || 'info' }, props.children)
    }

    function Empty(props) {
      return h('div', { className: 'dcm-empty' }, h('b', null, props.title), props.hint ? h('span', null, props.hint) : null)
    }

    function useFileEditor(onDirty) {
      const [path, setPath] = useState(null)
      const [text, setText] = useState('')
      const [mtime, setMtime] = useState(null)
      const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false)
      const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false)
      const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
      const [error, setError] = useState(null)
      const [conflict, setConflict] = useState(null)

      useEffect(() => {
        if (onDirty) onDirty(dirty)
      }, [dirty, onDirty])

      const reset = useCallback(() => {
        setPath(null)
        setText('')
        setMtime(null)
        setDirty(false)
        setSaved(false)
        setError(null)
        setConflict(null)
      }, [])

      const open = useCallback(async (target) => {
        if (!target || !target.path) return
        setBusy(true)
        try {
          const data = await request(API.read + '?path=' + encodeURIComponent(target.path))
          setPath(target.path)
          setText(typeof data.content === 'string' ? data.content : '')
          setMtime(typeof data.mtime === 'number' ? data.mtime : null)
          setDirty(false)
          setSaved(false)
          setError(null)
          setConflict(null)
        } catch (failure) {
          setError(failure.message)
        } finally {
          setBusy(false)
        }
      }, [])

      const save = useCallback(async () => {
        if (!path || busy) return
        setBusy(true)
        try {
          const data = await request(API.write, { method: 'POST', body: { path, content: text, baseMtime: mtime } })
          setMtime(typeof data.mtime === 'number' ? data.mtime : mtime)
          setDirty(false)
          setSaved(true)
          setError(null)
          setConflict(null)
        } catch (failure) {
          setError(failure.message)
          if (failure.status === 409 && failure.body) setConflict({ content: failure.body.content, mtime: failure.body.mtime })
        } finally {
          setBusy(false)
        }
      }, [path, text, mtime, busy])

      const change = useCallback((value) => {
        setText(value)
        setDirty(true)
        setSaved(false)
      }, [])

      const takeDisk = useCallback(() => {
        if (!conflict) return
        setText(typeof conflict.content === 'string' ? conflict.content : '')
        setMtime(typeof conflict.mtime === 'number' ? conflict.mtime : null)
        setDirty(false)
        setSaved(false)
        setError(null)
        setConflict(null)
      }, [conflict])

      const onKeyDown = useCallback(
        (event) => {
          if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && (event.key === 's' || event.key === 'S')) {
            event.preventDefault()
            save()
          }
        },
        [save],
      )

      return { path, text, dirty, saved, busy, error, conflict, open, save, reset, change, takeDisk, onKeyDown }
    }

    function EditorBox(props) {
      const ed = props.editor
      const lineCount = ed.text === '' ? 0 : ed.text.split('\n').length
      return h(
        'div',
        { className: 'dcm-main' },
        h(
          'div',
          { className: 'dcm-bar' },
          h('span', { className: 'dcm-path', title: ed.path || '' }, ed.path || ''),
          h(
            'button',
            { type: 'button', className: 'dcm-btn', disabled: !ed.path || ed.busy, onClick: () => ed.open({ path: ed.path }) },
            t('action.reload'),
          ),
          h(
            'button',
            { type: 'button', className: 'dcm-btn', 'data-kind': 'solid', disabled: !ed.path || ed.busy || !ed.dirty, onClick: () => ed.save() },
            t('action.save'),
          ),
        ),
        ed.conflict
          ? h(
              'div',
              { className: 'dcm-wire' },
              h('div', { className: 'dcm-wiretext' }, h('b', null, '磁盘上的文件变过了'), h('span', null, '保存会覆盖它。')),
              h('button', { type: 'button', className: 'dcm-btn', onClick: () => ed.takeDisk() }, t('action.takeDisk')),
            )
          : null,
        ed.error ? h(Notice, { tone: 'error' }, ed.error) : null,
        h('textarea', {
          className: 'dcm-editor',
          value: ed.text,
          spellCheck: false,
          disabled: !ed.path || ed.busy,
          placeholder: props.empty,
          onChange: (event) => ed.change(event.target.value),
          onKeyDown: ed.onKeyDown,
        }),
        h(
          'div',
          { className: 'dcm-foot' },
          h('span', { className: 'dcm-led', style: { background: statusColor(ed.error, ed.dirty, ed.saved) } }),
          h('span', null, statusLabel(ed.error, ed.dirty, ed.saved)),
          h('span', { className: 'dcm-grow' }),
          h('span', null, lineCount + ' ' + t('unit.lines') + ' · ' + formatSize(new TextEncoder().encode(ed.text).length)),
        ),
      )
    }

    /* ── the one page: every entry type in one list ── */
    function StudioPage() {
      const mode = useMode()
      const [data, setData] = useState({ roots: [], types: [], tools: [], presets: [] })
      const [selected, setSelected] = useState(null)
      const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
      const [error, setError] = useState(null)
      const [installBusy, setInstallBusy] = useState(false)
      const [closed, setClosed] = useState({})
      const [creating, setCreating] = useState(null)
      const [draft, setDraft] = useState({})
      const [newOpen, setNewOpen] = useState(false)
      const [newDraft, setNewDraft] = useState({})
      const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
      const ed = useFileEditor(null)

      const reload = useCallback(async () => {
        setLoading(true)
        try {
          const next = await request(API.presets)
          setData(next)
          setSelected((current) =>
            (next.presets || []).some((item) => item.dir === current) ? current : next.presets && next.presets[0] ? next.presets[0].dir : null,
          )
          setError(null)
        } catch (failure) {
          setError(failure.message)
        } finally {
          setLoading(false)
        }
      }, [])

      useEffect(() => {
        reload()
      }, [reload])

      const preset = (data.presets || []).find((item) => item.dir === selected) || (data.presets || [])[0] || null
      const types = data.types || []

      useEffect(() => {
        ed.reset()
        setCreating(null)
        setDraft({})
      }, [preset ? preset.dir : null])

      const openEntry = (entry) => {
        if (ed.dirty && ed.path && ed.path !== entry.path && !confirmText(t('confirm.discard'))) return
        ed.open(entry)
      }

      const toggleEntry = async (type, entry) => {
        setBusy(true)
        try {
          if (type.id === 'tool') {
            await request(API.toolToggle, { method: 'POST', body: { preset: preset.dir, id: entry.id, enabled: !entry.enabled } })
          } else {
            await request(API.toggle, { method: 'POST', body: { type: type.id, path: entry.path, enabled: !entry.enabled } })
          }
          setError(null)
          await reload()
        } catch (failure) {
          setError(failure.message)
        } finally {
          setBusy(false)
        }
      }

      const create = async (type, values) => {
        setBusy(true)
        try {
          const result = await request(API.create, { method: 'POST', body: { preset: preset.dir, type: type.id, values } })
          setCreating(null)
          setError(null)
          await reload()
          if (result && result.path) ed.open({ path: result.path })
        } catch (failure) {
          setError(failure.message)
        } finally {
          setBusy(false)
        }
      }

      const addTool = async (id) => {
        setBusy(true)
        try {
          await request(API.toolAdd, { method: 'POST', body: { preset: preset.dir, id } })
          setError(null)
          await reload()
        } catch (failure) {
          setError(failure.message)
        } finally {
          setBusy(false)
        }
      }

      const wire = async (type) => {
        setBusy(true)
        try {
          await request(API.wire, { method: 'POST', body: { preset: preset.dir, type: type.id } })
          setError(null)
          await reload()
        } catch (failure) {
          setError(failure.message)
        } finally {
          setBusy(false)
        }
      }

      const createPreset = async () => {
        if (busy) return
        setBusy(true)
        try {
          const result = await request(API.presetCreate, { method: 'POST', body: { title: newDraft.title || '', id: newDraft.id || '' } })
          setNewOpen(false)
          setNewDraft({})
          setError(null)
          await reload()
          if (result && result.dir) setSelected(result.dir)
        } catch (failure) {
          setError(failure.message)
        } finally {
          setBusy(false)
        }
      }

      const runInstall = async (route) => {        if (!preset || installBusy) return
        setInstallBusy(true)
        setError(null)
        try {
          await request(route, { method: 'POST', body: { preset: preset.dir } })
        } catch (failure) {
          if (failure && typeof failure.status === 'number') setError(failure.message)
        } finally {
          await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 900))
          await reload()
          setInstallBusy(false)
        }
      }

      const p = palette(mode)
      const rootStyle = {
        '--cm-surface': p.surface,
        '--cm-code': p.code,
        '--cm-card': p.card,
        '--cm-hairline': p.hairline,
        '--cm-hairline-strong': p.hairlineStrong,
        '--cm-active': p.active,
        '--cm-hover': p.hover,
        '--cm-blur': p.blur,
        '--cm-text': p.text,
        '--cm-text-dim': p.textDim,
        '--cm-accent': p.accent,
        '--cm-warn': p.warn,
        '--cm-error': p.error,
        '--cm-wire-tint': p.wireTint,
      }

      /* ── a create form for one type ── */
      const createForm = (type) => {
        if (type.create.hasCatalog) {
          const taken = new Set(((preset.entries.tool || {}).items || []).map((item) => item.id))
          const choices = (data.tools || []).filter((item) => !taken.has(item.id))
          return h(
            'div',
            { className: 'dcm-form' },
            choices.length === 0
              ? h('span', { className: 'dcm-sub' }, '能加的工具都加完了。')
              : h(
                  'div',
                  { style: { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 } },
                  ...choices.map((item) =>
                    h(
                      'button',
                      {
                        key: item.id,
                        type: 'button',
                        className: 'dcm-btn',
                        'data-kind': 'ghost',
                        style: { justifyContent: 'flex-start', textAlign: 'left' },
                        disabled: busy,
                        onClick: () => addTool(item.id),
                      },
                      item.label + ' · ' + item.hint,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
            h(
              'div',
              { className: 'dcm-actions' },
              h('button', { type: 'button', className: 'dcm-btn', 'data-kind': 'ghost', onClick: () => setCreating(null) }, t('action.cancel')),
            ),
          )
        }
        return h(
          'div',
          { className: 'dcm-form' },
          ...(type.create.fields || []).map((field) => {
            const setValue = (value) => setDraft((current) => ({ ...current, [field.key]: value }))
            const control =
              field.kind === 'select'
                ? h(
                    'select',
                    {
                      key: field.key,
                      className: 'dcm-input dcm-select',
                      value: draft[field.key] !== undefined ? draft[field.key] : field.default,
                      onChange: (event) => setValue(event.target.value),
                    },
                    ...(field.options || []).map((option) => h('option', { key: option.value, value: option.value }, option.label)),
                  )
                : h('input', {
                    key: field.key,
                    className: 'dcm-input',
                    type: field.kind === 'number' ? 'number' : 'text',
                    value: draft[field.key] !== undefined ? draft[field.key] : field.default !== undefined ? String(field.default) : '',
                    placeholder: field.label,
                    spellCheck: false,
                    onChange: (event) => setValue(event.target.value),
                  })
            return h(
              'div',
              { key: 'f-' + field.key, style: { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2 } },
              control,
              field.hint ? h('span', { className: 'dcm-note' }, field.hint) : null,
            )
          }),
          h(
            'div',
            { className: 'dcm-actions' },
            h(
              'button',
              {
                type: 'button',
                className: 'dcm-btn',
                'data-kind': 'ghost',
                onClick: () => {
                  setCreating(null)
                  setDraft({})
                },
              },
              t('action.cancel'),
            ),
            h('button', { type: 'button', className: 'dcm-btn', 'data-kind': 'solid', disabled: busy, onClick: () => create(type, draft) }, t('action.create')),
          ),
        )
      }

      /* ── one entry row ── */
      const entryRow = (type, entry) => {
        const chips = []
        if (type.id === 'inject') {
          chips.push(h(Chip, { key: 'r', text: entry.role === 'system' ? '系统提示词' : entry.role === 'user' ? '对话上下文' : '助手块' }))
          chips.push(h(Chip, { key: 'o', text: '序号 ' + entry.order }))
        }
        if (type.id === 'doc') chips.push(h(Chip, { key: 'c', text: (entry.chars || 0) + ' ' + t('unit.chars') }))
        if (entry.valid === false) chips.push(h(Chip, { key: 'w', text: '⚠ 缺字段' }))
        const switchable = type.id !== 'files' && type.toggleField !== null
        return h(
          'div',
          { key: entry.path || entry.id, className: 'dcm-item', 'data-on': ed.path === entry.path ? '1' : '0' },
          h(
            'button',
            { type: 'button', className: 'dcm-itemmain', title: entry.path || '', onClick: () => (entry.path ? openEntry(entry) : null) },
            h('span', { className: 'dcm-name' }, entry.name || entry.id),
            h('span', { className: 'dcm-sub' }, entry.preview || entry.description || entry.packageName || ''),
            chips.length > 0 ? h('span', { className: 'dcm-chips' }, ...chips) : null,
          ),
          switchable
            ? h(Switch, {
                on: entry.enabled,
                disabled: busy || entry.auto === true || entry.valid === false,
                label: entry.name || entry.id,
                title: entry.auto ? t('notice.toolAuto') : '',
                onChange: () => toggleEntry(type, entry),
              })
            : null,
        )
      }

      /* ── one type group ── */
      const group = (type) => {
        const section = preset ? preset.entries[type.id] : null
        const items = type.id === 'files' ? preset.files : section ? section.items : []
        const isClosed = closed[type.id] === true
        const wiring = section ? section.wiring : null
        const missing = wiring && wiring.missing.length > 0
        const head = h(
          'button',
          {
            type: 'button',
            className: 'dcm-gh',
            'data-closed': isClosed ? '1' : '0',
            onClick: () => setClosed((current) => ({ ...current, [type.id]: !current[type.id] })),
          },
          h('span', { className: 'dcm-caret' }, '▾'),
          h('span', null, type.label),
          h('span', { className: 'dcm-n' }, items.length),
          h('span', { className: 'dcm-grow' }),
          wiring && type.consumers.length > 0 && !missing ? h(Chip, { text: t('state.wired') }) : null,
          missing ? h(Chip, { text: '未接上' }) : null,
        )
        return h(
          'div',
          { key: type.id },
          head,
          isClosed
            ? null
            : h(
                'div',
                null,
                missing
                  ? h(
                      'div',
                      { className: 'dcm-wire' },
                      h('div', { className: 'dcm-wiretext' }, h('b', null, t('wire.missing')), h('span', null, wiring.missing.join('、'))),
                      h('button', { type: 'button', className: 'dcm-btn', 'data-kind': 'solid', disabled: busy, onClick: () => wire(type) }, t('action.wire')),
                    )
                  : null,
                ...items.map((entry) => entryRow(type, entry)),
                items.length === 0 ? h(Empty, { title: t('notice.empty') }) : null,
                type.create
                  ? creating === type.id
                    ? createForm(type)
                    : h(
                        'button',
                        {
                          type: 'button',
                          className: 'dcm-btn',
                          'data-kind': 'ghost',
                          style: { marginTop: 4, alignSelf: 'flex-start', marginLeft: 6 },
                          onClick: () => {

      "path": "packages/studio/inject.js",
      "content": "/**
 * Injection delivery — a preset-side part with no UI of its own.
 *
 * A preset that wants its `注入` folder delivered adds one row to its patch.
 * The injector ships inside the `dsh-preset-studio` package as the `./inject`
 * subpath, so it arrives with the panel instead of as a second install:
 *
 *   - id: studio-inject
 *     name: 'dsh-preset-studio/inject'
 *     config:
 *       dir: '<preset dir>\注入'
 *
 * Every enabled `<dir>/*.md` becomes one prompt contribution, ordered by the
 * file's `order` field:
 *
 *   role: system     → a prompt section, so it renders inside the system prompt
 *   role: user       → a runtime context block, which reaches the model as a
 *                      sourced user snapshot ("注入内容")
 *   role: assistant  → no native channel exists; delivered as a context block
 *
 * The relative `depth` field is not honoured: neither channel can place text
 * between conversation messages.
 *
 * Two things this deliberately does NOT do in a single mount:
 *
 *   1. The text of a contribution is a function that re-reads its file, so
 *      editing an injection in the panel lands on the next turn. A static
 *      string would freeze the body at mount time — the panel would save the
 *      file and the model would keep reading yesterday's text.
 *   2. The folder is watched, and the whole registration set is rebuilt when
 *      files are added, removed, or change role. Without this a newly created
 *      injection is invisible until the preset is mounted again, which looks
 *      exactly like "this feature does not work".
 *
 * The whole body is defensive. A preset row that throws fails the agent it
 * belongs to, so a bad injection folder must degrade to "nothing injected".
 */
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import { readBoolean, readField, readNumber, splitFrontmatter } from './frontmatter.js'

/** Stable cordis plugin name. */
export const name = 'dsh-preset-studio/inject'
/** The prompt registry is the only service this row needs. */
export const inject = ['systemPrompt']

/** User sections land after tool guidance and before the environment facts. */
const SECTION_BASE = 8000
/** User context blocks land after every built-in runtime fact. */
const CONTEXT_BASE = 500
/** Coalesce the burst of events one editor save produces. */
const WATCH_DEBOUNCE_MS = 150

/** The body of one injection file, without its frontmatter. */
function bodyOf(file) {
  let text = ''
  try {
    text = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')
  } catch {
    return ''
  }
  const split = splitFrontmatter(text)
  if (!split) return ''
  return split.rest.trim()
}

/** Every injection file in one folder, ordered by its own 序号. */
function readEntries(dir) {
  let children = []
  try {
    children = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })
  } catch {
    return []
  }
  const entries = []
  for (const child of children) {
    if (!child.isFile() || !child.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.md')) continue
    const file = path.join(dir, child.name)
    let text = ''
    try {
      text = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')
    } catch {
      continue
    }
    const split = splitFrontmatter(text)
    if (!split) continue
    if (split.rest.trim() === '') continue
    const rawRole = (readField(split.head, 'role') || 'system').toLowerCase()
    entries.push({
      file,
      name: readField(split.head, 'name') || child.name.slice(0, -3),
      role: rawRole === 'user' || rawRole === 'assistant' ? rawRole : 'system',
      order: readNumber(split.head, 'order') ?? 0,
      enabled: readBoolean(readField(split.head, 'enabled')) !== false,
    })
  }
  entries.sort((left, right) => left.order - right.order || left.name.localeCompare(right.name, 'zh-Hans-CN'))
  return entries
}

/** Accept both disposable shapes Cordis hands back (function or `{ dispose }`). */
function runDisposer(handle) {
  if (typeof handle === 'function') handle()
  else if (handle && typeof handle.dispose === 'function') handle.dispose()
}

/** Mount the folder as prompt contributions, and keep them in step with it. */
export function apply(ctx, config) {
  try {
    const declared = typeof config?.dir === 'string' ? config.dir.trim() : ''
    if (declared === '') {
      ctx.logger?.warn?.('[studio-inject] config.dir is missing; nothing injected')
      return
    }
    const dir = path.resolve(declared)
    let handles = []

    const unmount = () => {
      for (const handle of handles) {
        try {
          runDisposer(handle)
        } catch {
          /* a disposer that fails must not block the rebuild */
        }
      }
      handles = []
    }

    const mount = () => {
      unmount()
      let sections = 0
      let contexts = 0
      for (const entry of readEntries(dir)) {
        if (!entry.enabled) continue
        const system = entry.role === 'system'
        const contribution = {
          name: 'custom-inject:' + entry.name,
          order: (system ? SECTION_BASE : CONTEXT_BASE) + entry.order,
          // Re-read on every assembly: editing the file is the normal case, and
          // a frozen body would silently contradict what the panel shows.
          text: () => bodyOf(entry.file),
          interpolate: false,
        }
        try {
          const handle = system ? ctx.systemPrompt.section(contribution) : ctx.systemPrompt.context(contribution)
          handles.push(handle)
          if (system) sections += 1
          else contexts += 1
        } catch (error) {
          ctx.logger?.warn?.('[studio-inject] ' + entry.file + ': ' + String(error?.message ?? error))
        }
      }
      ctx.logger?.info?.(
        '[studio-inject] ' + dir + ': ' + sections + ' section(s) + ' + contexts + ' context(s)',
      )
    }

    mount()

    // Structural changes need a fresh registration; text edits do not.
    let timer = null
    let watcher = null
    let dead = false
    const close = () => {
      dead = true
      if (timer !== null) clearTimeout(timer)
      timer = null
      try {
        watcher?.close()
      } catch {
        /* already closed */
      }
      watcher = null
      unmount()
    }
    try {
      watcher = fs.watch(dir, { persistent: false }, () => {
        if (dead) return
        if (timer !== null) clearTimeout(timer)
        timer = setTimeout(() => {
          timer = null
          if (dead) return
          try {
            mount()
          } catch (error) {
            ctx.logger?.warn?.('[studio-inject] remount failed: ' + String(error?.message ?? error))
          }
        }, WATCH_DEBOUNCE_MS)
      })
      if (typeof watcher.unref === 'function') watcher.unref()
    } catch (error) {
      ctx.logger?.warn?.('[studio-inject] cannot watch ' + dir + ': ' + String(error?.message ?? error))
    }

    if (typeof ctx.effect === 'function') ctx.effect(() => close, 'custom-injector.watch()')
    else if (typeof ctx.on === 'function') ctx.on('dispose', close)
  } catch (error) {
    ctx.logger?.warn?.('[studio-inject] failed: ' + String(error?.message ?? error))
  }
}

      "path": "packages/studio/docs.js",
      "content": "/**
 * Document write-back — a preset-side part with no UI of its own.
 *
 * A preset's documents (`<preset>/文档/*.md`) are listed to the model by the
 * skill provider, which only ever hands out text: there is no way for the model
 * to write one back. This plugin adds that one capability, and nothing else:
 * a single `doc_update` tool that appends to, or replaces, the body of a
 * document that already exists. It never creates a document and never touches
 * the frontmatter, so the catalog entry the model is looking at stays valid.
 *
 * It ships inside the `dsh-preset-studio` package as the `./docs` subpath, so
 * a preset adds one row and gets the tool:
 *
 *   - id: studio-docs
 *     name: 'dsh-preset-studio/docs'
 *     config:
 *       dir: '<preset dir>\文档'
 *
 * It deliberately imports no `@deepseek-ai/*` package: a tool definition is a
 * plain object (`tools.register` needs `output.render` and a JSON schema), so
 * this part runs — and can be unit-tested — without the host's module map.
 */
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import { splitFrontmatter } from './frontmatter.js'

/** Stable cordis plugin name. */
export const name = 'dsh-preset-studio/docs'
/** The tool registry is the only service this plugin needs. */
export const inject = ['tools']

/** The two write modes. There is no "create": the panel owns that. */
const MODES = ['append', 'replace']

/** Every document in `dir`, with the name the model knows it by. */
function listDocs(dir) {
  let children = []
  try {
    children = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })
  } catch {
    return []
  }
  const docs = []
  for (const child of children) {
    if (!child.isFile() || !child.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.md')) continue
    const file = path.join(dir, child.name)
    let text = ''
    try {
      text = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8')
    } catch {
      continue
    }
    const split = splitFrontmatter(text)
    const stem = child.name.slice(0, -3)
    const declared = split ? /^\s*name:\s*(.+?)\s*$/m.exec(split.head) : null
    const label = declared ? declared[1].replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '').trim() : stem
    docs.push({ file, text, split, stem, name: label || stem })
  }
  return docs
}

/** Write one file atomically, so a failed write never truncates a document. */
function writeAtomic(target, content) {
  const tmp = target + '.tmp-' + process.pid + '-' + Date.now()
  fs.writeFileSync(tmp, content, 'utf8')
  fs.renameSync(tmp, target)
}

/** The model-facing description. It must say when to call, not just what it does. */
const DESCRIPTION = [
  'Write something back into one of this preset\'s documents (文档), so a later turn — or a later conversation — starts from the updated understanding instead of the old one.',
  'The document list lives in the skill catalog: each document appears there by name with its description. Read the document with the `skill` tool first; that is the only way to see its current text.',
  'Use `append` (the default choice) to add a dated section after what is already there — this is how experience accumulates. Use `replace` only to rewrite the whole body, for example when earlier notes turned out to be wrong and would mislead a later turn.',
  'The frontmatter (name and description) is never changed by this tool.',
].join(' ')

/** The JSON schema shown to the model, and the contract its arguments obey. */
const PARAMETERS = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: {
    doc: {
      type: 'string',
      description: 'The document name exactly as it appears in the skill catalog (or its file name without .md).',
    },
    mode: {
      type: 'string',
      enum: MODES,
      description: 'append adds a new section at the end; replace overwrites the whole body.',
    },
    content: {
      type: 'string',
      description: 'The text to write, in Markdown. No frontmatter: it is preserved for you.',
    },
  },
  required: ['doc', 'mode', 'content'],
}

/** The validated output of one write, already in JSON Schema form. */
const OUTPUT = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: {
    doc: { type: 'string' },
    mode: { type: 'string' },
    path: { type: 'string' },
    chars: { type: 'integer' },
    lines: { type: 'integer' },
  },
  required: ['doc', 'mode', 'path', 'chars', 'lines'],
}

/**
 * Mount `doc_update`.
 * @param ctx - registrant context carrying the tool registry.
 * @param config - `{ dir }`, the preset's 文档 directory.
 */
export function apply(ctx, config) {
  const dir = typeof config?.dir === 'string' ? path.resolve(config.dir) : ''
  if (dir === '') {
    ctx.logger?.warn?.('[studio-docs] config.dir is missing; doc_update is not registered')
    return
  }
  ctx.tools.register({
    name: 'doc_update',
    description: DESCRIPTION,
    parameters: PARAMETERS,
    output: {
      schema: OUTPUT,
      render: (_args, value) => [
        {
          type: 'text',
          text:
            'Wrote ' + value.chars + ' characters into `' + value.doc + '` (' + value.mode + '). ' +
            'The document now has ' + value.lines + ' lines. It keeps its place in the catalog.',
        },
      ],
    },
    execute(args) {
      const doc = typeof args?.doc === 'string' ? args.doc.trim() : ''
      const mode = typeof args?.mode === 'string' ? args.mode.trim() : ''
      const content = typeof args?.content === 'string' ? args.content : ''
      if (doc === '') throw new Error('doc is required: pass the document name from the skill catalog')
      if (!MODES.includes(mode)) throw new Error('mode must be one of: ' + MODES.join(', '))
      if (content.trim() === '') throw new Error('content is empty: nothing to write')
      const docs = listDocs(dir)
      if (docs.length === 0) throw new Error('this preset has no documents under ' + dir)
      const hit =
        docs.find((entry) => entry.name === doc) ||
        docs.find((entry) => entry.name.toLowerCase() === doc.toLowerCase()) ||
        docs.find((entry) => entry.stem.toLowerCase() === doc.toLowerCase())
      if (!hit) {
        throw new Error(
          'no document named "' + doc + '". Available: ' + docs.map((entry) => entry.name).join(', '),
        )
      }
      if (!hit.split) {
        throw new Error('document "' + hit.name + '" has no frontmatter, so the model cannot see it; fix it in the panel first')
      }
      const eol = hit.split.eol || '\n'
      const body = hit.split.rest || ''
      const next = mode === 'append' ? (body.trim() === '' ? content : body.replace(/\s+$/, '') + eol + eol + content) : content
      const text = '---' + eol + hit.split.head + eol + '---' + eol + next
      writeAtomic(hit.file, text)
      return {
        doc: hit.name,
        mode,
        path: hit.file,
        chars: content.length,
        lines: text.split(/\r?\n/).length,
      }
    },
  })
}
